extDescription.message: Dual subtitles for YouTube: every line in the original and in your language. Free, unlimited, no sign-in. Translated on your device.

buttonOn.message: Twinsub dual subtitles: on (click to turn off)

buttonOff.message: Twinsub dual subtitles: off (click to turn on)

noApi.message: Twinsub translates on your computer, which needs Chrome 138 or newer on a desktop or laptop.

unsupported.message: On-device translation from $1 to $2 isn't available in Chrome yet. Showing the original subtitles.

needsDownload.message: Click to download the $1 → $2 translation pack (one time, a few seconds)

noCaptions.message: This video has no subtitles, so Twinsub has nothing to translate.

popupHow.message: Open any YouTube video with subtitles. Twinsub turns them on and adds the translation; the button with two lines in the player bar switches it off.

popupPrivacy.message: Subtitles are translated on your computer by Chrome's built-in translator. Only when you tap Explain are the marked words and the nearby subtitle lines sent to our server to write the answer. No account.

panelHint.message: Mark the parts of the translation you don't get, as many as you like. Or explain the whole line.

panelHintNoTr.message: Mark the parts you don't get, as many as you like. Or explain the whole line.

aiNote.message: Written by AI, may be wrong

quotaBody.message: They come back tomorrow. Your marks stay where they are.

errBusy.message: Lots of people are asking right now. Try again in a minute.

quotaBodyPro.message: They come back on the 1st of next month.

quotaRestoreHint.message: Already have Pro or Lifetime? Enter your code in the Twinsub menu (the extension icon).

proPitch.message: 1,000 explanations a month instead of 5 a day. $$4.99 a month, cancel anytime.

proHave.message: Already have Pro? Enter your code

proBadCode.message: That code isn't active. Check it, or write to hello@poeticalengine.com.

proTooMany.message: This code is already used on 5 computers.

proCodeLabel.message: Your Pro code, for your other computers:

proEnds.message: Pro ends on $1 and won't renew.

quotaOwnKey.message: Or $$14.90 once: your own API key, nothing through our server

byokLocked.message: Your own API key is turned on, but it isn't unlocked on this computer. Get Lifetime or enter your code in the AI settings.

byokSetup.message: Your own API key is turned on but not set up yet.

byokKeyBad.message: $1 turned down your API key. Check it in the AI settings.

byokRate.message: $1 says you've hit your rate limit or run out of credit.

popupAi.message: AI settings · use your own API key

proOrLifetime.message: Or pay once ($$14.90): your own API key, explanations never pass through our server

optHosted.message: Twinsub: 5 free a day, or 1,000 a month with Pro

optOwn.message: My own API key, sent straight to my provider

optLt1.message: Your own key, your choice of AI: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and more, or any compatible endpoint.

optLt2.message: More private: explanations go straight from Chrome to your provider. Twinsub's server never sees what you watch or ask.

optLt3.message: No Twinsub limits: explain as much as your provider allows.

optLt4.message: Pay once, $$14.90. Up to 5 computers, no subscription.

optLifetimePitch.message: You pay your AI provider for what you use. Dual subtitles stay free.

optHaveCode.message: Already bought it? Enter your code

optUnlocked.message: Your own API key is unlocked on this computer.

optUnlockedPro.message: Included with your Pro subscription while it lasts.

optLifetimeCode.message: Your Lifetime code, for your other computers:

optKeySaved.message: Saved ($1). Leave this empty to keep it.

optKeyNone.message: Not needed for a local server.

optModelsLoaded.message: $1 models loaded. Pick one in the Model field.

optPermDenied.message: Without permission to reach $1, Twinsub can't call this provider.

optNeedUrl.message: Enter a full base URL, starting with https://

optPrivacy.message: Your key is encrypted and kept only on this computer: it is never synced and never sent to Twinsub. With your own key, explanations go straight from Chrome to the provider you chose, under that provider's terms, and never pass through Twinsub's server.
